caption:
The scariest sounds in a Fairfield County house aren't coming from the trick-or-treaters. 🎃

A drip under the sink. Scratching in the walls. A furnace that clicks on and blows nothing. And the classic: "I'll be there between 8 and 12."

Coming Soon: My House Guardian, to handle the scary stuff for you. Send this to the homeowner who's heard all four.

Your house, our problems.
